_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 8, HUG FOR STRANGER / TEL AVIV TAL, the cut with people speaking. V4 = RECUT on Tal's note (TAL-NOTES-ROUND-1 row 32: 'when he asks me what I'm doing, then it continues as a voiceover - no. Just people coming up and running up to me. Zoom in and add some music.'). The question ('what made you do this concept') and Tal's answer are OUT, and nothing is heard over another picture any more: every line is said in its own shot. Shape: 'Come give me a hug' -> the white-cap hug ('I love you, bro' / 'the world needs more love right now') -> the tourist's hug ('How are you?') -> a man with a backpack walks up ('What's up, my brother? How are you?' ... 'Thank you so much, man') -> 4th, the strongest: arms wide ('Come'), a woman runs in, snap-in, slow-mo embrace, 'You are so beautiful. Keep smiling.' -> 'The world needs more love, bro. Keep spreading positivity.' -> the man in the beige shirt ('How are you, my brother?' hug) -> 'I love you.' 'Me too.' END. Closer framing: one constant crop per shot, aimed on stills. Differs from FAST: opens on the spoken ask (Fast opens on the poster), has the backpack man and the tourist (neither in Fast); a young woman's hug ('I missed you so much', 5684 31-34) was tried and taken out again because teenage-looking girls walk through the background of that shot, keeps real voices and captions. Music: none yet - Tal supplies tracks; room tone from this shoot (5682 61.6-95.3, no speech) sits under the dialogue at the builder's 0.14 so the joins do not drop to digital silence. Children: the opener is framed x0-0.70 (four children stand at frame right); the boy who walks in behind the pink-shirt man is blurred on the render (blur-rules.json). Captions from the transcripts (5676/5682/5683/5667 WhisperX-aligned, 5685 hand-timed from two engines + RMS; see hand_fixed in each). Final file = EK_HUGS_TELAVIV_VOICES_V4.mp4 (blurred); _noblur must not be delivered.
